items.name: use-click-outside
items.title: useClickOutside
items.description: Close a popover or menu when the pointer lands outside its root.

items.name: change-summary
items.title: Change Summary
items.description: Collapsed files-changed card with +/- stats, a Review action, and a WorkedFor elapsed-time badge.

items.name: generation-status
items.title: Generation Status
items.description: Quiet pulsing-dot status for a run that has not produced its first token yet, with an optional stage label.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme Toggle
items.description: Circular light/dark toggle — floating by default, inline via `floating={false}`.

items.name: chat-navbar
items.title: Chat Navbar
items.description: Thin top bar with truncating title and left/right slots.

items.name: chat-input
items.title: Chat Input
items.description: Composer with attachments, drag-and-drop, a skills/slash menu, and Enter-to-send.

items.name: prompt-suggestions
items.title: Prompt Suggestions
items.description: Minimal starter-prompt list for an empty chat — full-width rows with optional icons.

items.name: mode-picker
items.title: Mode Picker
items.description: Ask / Plan / Agent mode switch built on the shadcn dropdown menu.

items.name: model-picker
items.title: Model Picker
items.description: Searchable model selector with badges, descriptions, disabled options, and an optional reasoning-effort row.

items.name: message-markdown
items.title: Message Markdown
items.description: Streamdown renderer for assistant markdown: GFM, code, Mermaid, KaTeX, and inline data: images.

items.name: ask-question
items.title: Ask Question
items.description: Cursor-style questionnaire: single- and multi-select questions, an Other… field, Skip and Continue.

items.name: message-parts
items.title: Message Parts
items.description: Atomic assistant parts: the "Worked for 12s" process group, reasoning, tool calls, ask questions, highlighted code, and artifacts.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: Memoized user bubble and assistant message: live parts while streaming, collapsed into a "Worked for 12s" process group with the answer and a change summary once the turn settles.

items.name: message-list
items.title: Message List
items.description: Scrollable message list with smart auto-scroll, stable edit callbacks, and generation status.

items.name: sidebar-dnd
items.title: Sidebar DnD
items.description: Declarative drag-and-drop context for sidebar items: generic drop zones (pin/trash presets) plus drag-to-reorder events.

items.name: sidebar-drop-zones
items.title: Sidebar Drop Zones
items.description: Edge and inline drop zones rendered from a zone definition, with tone variants and drag-over highlighting.

items.name: sidebar-item
items.title: Sidebar Item
items.description: Memoized session row plus sortable list: single- or multi-line rows (subtitle, meta, folder/branch badge) or fully custom content, rename, pin, delete, status dots, context menu, drag and drag-to-reorder.

items.name: chat-sidebar
items.title: Chat Sidebar
items.description: Collapsible sidebar chrome with slot-based composition and generic drag-and-drop zones (pin, trash, custom).

items.name: chat
items.title: Chat
items.description: Responsive chat block composed from the atomic components: a centered greeting, composer and starter prompts that settle into the message list on the first send.
